{3: 'The door to your detective agency has been fixed.'}
{3: 'With brand-new brass hinges, it opens with a gentle push.'}
{3: 'Eileena, so used to shouldering the door open, launches herself straight into the room. She stumbles forward a few steps before catching her footing, nearly sending her steak sandwich flying.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eileena', 3: "You could've warned me you fixed the door!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: 'I slammed into it for nothing!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'No response, as usual.'}
{3: 'You stand before the detective board, taking down everything pinned to it.'}
{3: 'Photographs, clippings, cargo records, and court documents... The vast web of red strings comes apart thread by thread after half a year, revealing the worn, patchy wall beneath.'}
{3: "Nirvatia's name, pinned at the center of it all, is the last to come down. You study it for a moment, then slide it into a drawer."}
{1: '1', 3: 'Eileena sidles over, sandwich in hand, and begins her report.'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: 'Oh, and get this: the Velosenne situation has been settled.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: 'Lady Nirvatia has officially returned home. Margaret and Jagienka presided over the ceremony, with the whole family in attendance.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: "Oh, and those guards who chased us all over the ballroom? Every last one of them got assigned a month's worth of stair-scrubbing duty.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: "As for that old rat who opened fire from the second floor... word is Lady Nirvatia paid him a personal visit. Sounds like he won't be seeing daylight anytime soon!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Anything else?', 3: '32'}
{3: 'Eileena sets her sandwich down and puffs out her cheeks.'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: "Here's another thing... I have a bone to pick with you!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: 'Whatever happened to "we eat, and we leave"? I didn\'t even get a single bite of the lobster!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: 'I had to go flip the breaker alone in the dark, with armed guards crawling all over the corridors! I nearly died in that utility room!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: "If I hadn't killed the lights, do you think you two would've made it to the courtyard in one piece? When you get down to it, I'm the real hero here, aren't I?!", 4: '1'}
{3: "You don't say a word, just listening with a smile."}
{3: "The door's fixed, the bills are paid, and the assistant is nagging away..."}
{3: 'Somehow, this just feels like enough.'}
{3: 'Eileena stops mid-rant, catching something with her eyes.'}
{3: 'While listening to her, you pin something new to the freshly cleared detective board.'}
{3: 'A hand-drawn sketch.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eileena', 3: '...What is this supposed to be? A possessed octopus?', 4: '18'}
{3: 'On the paper is a mass of tangled, tendril-like appendages, each one straight, segmented, and connected at the end to a perfectly square "head."'}
{2: 'When we defeated the Lone Emperor, I caught a glimpse of something.', 3: '63'}
{2: 'The memory shards left behind by the first head are almost all a blur.', 3: '64'}
{2: "Whoever she made the contract with wasn't the ancient god she thought.", 3: '65'}
{2: 'It had "tentacles," and a square "brain."', 3: '66'}
{3: 'Eileena stares at the sketch for a long moment, then shudders.'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: '...This case is looking a lot more complicated than we thought.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: "Good timing, actually. I've got some things to go over on my end too.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She pulls a stack of cards from her coat.'}
{1: '1003', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Kamui. Veronica. Alpha.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eileena', 3: 'Every named Aberration in the city I could track down is here.', 4: '18'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory352.jpg'}
{3: 'You raise an eyebrow, take the cards, and pin them to the wall one by one.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eileena', 3: 'That said, none of them are easy to get to. For a small agency like ours...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Things are different now.', 3: '101'}
{2: 'We have the head of the Velosenne family on our side.', 3: '102'}
{2: "Getting to them shouldn't be nearly as hard anymore.", 3: '103'}
{3: "Eileena's eyes narrow, and she jabs you with her elbow."}
{2: 'Eileena', 3: 'So, what exactly is going on between you and the head of the family, anyway?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'You just smile and say nothing.'}
{3: 'Your gaze drifts past the freshly pinned detective board and out the window.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V460hua01.png'}
{3: 'On the windowsill sits a glass bottle with a single white flower.'}

{1: 'The Velosenne Family'}
{2: 'The Velosenne Family'}
{3: 'The Velosenne mansion blazes with light, its usual gloom swept away entirely.'}
{3: 'The hall is dressed once more in the decorations from the night of the ball, the musicians are playing Waltz in A Minor, and at the center of the long table sits a strawberry cake——'}
{3: 'The cake, the music, the decorations... All of it is exactly as it was that night.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Nirvatia stands frozen in the doorway of the hall, her mouth slightly agape.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'This is...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jagienka', 3: 'A belated happy birthday to you!', 4: '15'}
{3: "Before she can finish, Jagienka shoves an entire slice of strawberry cake into Nirvatia's mouth. Her cheeks puffed out, she cannot speak a single word."}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'I—mmph!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Jagienka plants her hands on her hips, her chin tilted up with satisfaction.'}
{2: 'Jagienka', 3: "That one's for ten-year-old me!", 4: '15'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Beside them, Margaret is doubled over laughing.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Nirvatia struggles to swallow the cake, shooting Jagienka a withering glare, though her eyes are a little red around the edges.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'So... childish.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The three of them settle around the long table together.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Margaret', 3: "Speaking of which, where's detective 【kuroname】?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Margaret', 3: "How come the detective didn't come with you this time?", 4: '2'}

{3: 'The words are barely out when a dark mist coalesces on her shoulder, solidifying into wings and settling down. The newly-formed black raven tilts his head to one side, speaking with a voice far too loud for his size.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Morigan', 3: "Oho, now that's the question!", 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Jagienka nearly jumps out of her skin.'}
{2: 'Jagienka', 3: 'A-a talking raven?!', 4: '3'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Morigan', 3: 'Oh, you two really missed out! After leaving the forbidden grounds, a certain someone and the detective were leaning against each other and sitting on the cemetery steps from the dead of night till dawn!', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Morigan', 3: 'Oh, and get this! The moment the detective reached out, a certain someone just slipped her hand right in. Tsk, tsk, tsk—', 4: '18'}
{3: "Nirvatia's ears turn red at a visibly alarming rate."}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'My power may have returned... but it might not be a good idea to keep you by my side forever, bird.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Morigan', 3: 'A raven! I am a raven!', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Morigan', 3: 'Use me and toss me aside? Ladies, you be the judge—', 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Jagienka has already sidled over, her eyes gleaming with an almost frightening eagerness.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Margaret', 3: "See? I knew leaving her in the detective's hands was the right call.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Jagienka', 3: 'Leaning against each other? Then what? What happened next?', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'You two—!', 4: '1'}
{3: "Taunts, laughter, and the raven's incessant squawking all erupt at once."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "I'm meeting up with 【kuroname】 soon, anyway.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'To discuss our next move.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "...It's strictly business!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Morigan', 3: "Oh sure, strictly business... That's why you're leaving an hour early!", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Margaret', 3: 'Maybe you should wear that prettiest dress in your closet—', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "There's no need...", 4: '1'}
{3: "Nirvatia makes a beeline for the door as the two girls' unabashed squealing chases her all the way out."}
{3: 'The raven flutters out the window after Nirvatia, his squawking complaints fading into the distance.'}
